responsibility: Defines the machine abstraction that parameterizes the MIR interpreter over memory kinds, pointer tags, stack representation, allocation metadata, and host-specific hooks for calls, stack transitions, memory access, provenance, and error handling, plus a shared compile-time machine default configuration.
same_name_distinction: This `machine.rs` defines the generic interpreter `Machine` abstraction and shared compile-time-machine macro used by interpreter clients. The `const_eval/machine.rs` file is one concrete machine implementation with CTFE-specific policy and error behavior.
